private-equity.name: Christopher Hover Upton-Hansen
private-equity.quote: Extremely thorough, genuinely focused on the practical reality and giving you the right tools as a professional and preparing you for what to expect. Best course I've done bar none.

private-equity.name: Jubin Jacob
private-equity.quote: The course structure and weekly content are thoughtfully laid out in a digestible manner. The directors are highly engaged during office hours and our peer group is top-notch — smart, kind, and experienced individuals who make the networking especially enjoyable.

private-equity.name: Capricia Sampson
private-equity.quote: The Wharton Online and Wall Street Prep Certificate Program has been extremely helpful in helping me understand the full investment lifecycle. I think anyone interested in Private Equity would find this course beneficial.

private-equity.name: Savannah Tufts
private-equity.quote: Very well organized modules that optimize ability to comprehend in a compact program. Instructors articulate the concepts for all learning levels. Electives are immensely helpful.

private-equity.name: Karthik Thomas Mathew
private-equity.quote: The course materials and video lectures are extremely helpful to obtain an understanding of the private equity landscape. Compared to other online courses I've done, the level of comprehensiveness put forward here is really commendable.

private-equity.name: Arham Rizavi
private-equity.quote: You learn the details that go behind the business acumen. These details made me better at observation, analysis, data assessment, and how to improve the current structure of a business.

private-equity.name: Vesela Tyler
private-equity.quote: Amazing instructor, explains thoroughly and in detail so you are able to learn and start to actually enjoy LBO modeling. Even though the material is very complex, it is one of my favorite classes in this course!

private-equity.name: Justin Butcher
private-equity.quote: Absolutely fantastic course. I've already recommended it to a few of my buddies. It's amazing that you're making this kind of education accessible to the masses for this price — seriously, good job team.

private-equity.name: Jacob Schepps
private-equity.quote: Chris Reilly is the greatest teacher ever. Very good at explaining to someone not proficient in Excel without taking too much time. He always puts himself in the student's perspective when explaining.

real-estate.name: Shannon Kennedy
real-estate.quote: This course condensed everything into 8 weeks and really got to the key aspects of real estate investing that I struggled to fully understand before. The open office hours and one-on-one availability have been invaluable. I cannot thank the Wharton/Wall Street Prep partnership enough for this offering.

real-estate.name: Shannon Scott
real-estate.quote: I am already applying the financial modeling concepts I learned here in real time to a development project I am currently brokering. As an emerging developer, I find this certificate program incredibly valuable.

real-estate.name: Colton Hock
real-estate.quote: As a young real estate investor and professional I built so much on my current understanding of practical concepts within the industry. I thought about retaking this class every year to always brush up on understanding as the RE market continually shifts.

real-estate.name: Suzy Alford
real-estate.quote: The quality of instruction and materials are fantastic, from the Wharton professors, to Wall Street Prep's modeling instruction, to the interviews with industry leaders.

real-estate.name: Philip Rechsteiner
real-estate.quote: I find the information to be very informative and provides a great combination of theoretical knowledge and real-world experience from the guest speakers. The conversations with Dean Adler and Hal Fetner are particularly valuable — you would not be able to learn this from just a textbook.

real-estate.name: Ashley Bossert
real-estate.quote: It teaches real-world practical knowledge and skills by some of the top professors in the country at a reasonable price and with flexibility. I love the networking opportunities and the ability to speak with experts in the field.

real-estate.name: Brian Keaton
real-estate.quote: The content is challenging and informative, the Excel exercises are very helpful, and the guest lectures are interesting. I've really enjoyed the course and have learned a lot, which I'm already implementing daily.

real-estate.name: Lily Friedland
real-estate.quote: This course has been extremely helpful in establishing a foundation in real estate investing. I would certainly recommend it to anyone starting out.

real-estate.name: Adam Young
real-estate.quote: I thought the program was extremely well constructed, covering all the major elements of real estate analysis and modeling. Dan and Aaron did a great job, and the insights from the professors were terrific. I could not have been more pleased.

fpa.name: Jessie Tran
fpa.quote: I've attended a few certificate programs at another prestigious university, but the FP&A certificate program at Wharton Online is the best I've attended. The curriculum is very informative and well-designed, covering all the aspects that help students to be successful from technical skills to people skills.

fpa.name: Carlos P. Menchaca
fpa.quote: This program helped me connect the dots and gain a deep understanding of the financial planning and analysis process within my organization. It has significantly enhanced my ability to contribute strategically to our business. I highly recommend this course to anyone looking to strengthen their FP&A knowledge.

fpa.name: Madelinen Carrion
fpa.quote: The program equips you with the latest skill sets for today's business environment, and the hands-on exercises build the mental muscle to develop and refine technical skills on your own. A real game-changer for those looking to enter into or advance in the FP&A field.

fpa.name: Chera Burwell
fpa.quote: This course provides very hands-on, real world experience and explains how to think and what questions to ask. It is very helpful no matter what stage of your career and no matter if you are working for a company or an entrepreneur.

fpa.name: Shujie Breither
fpa.quote: This program condenses the essence of Financial Planning & Analysis, allowing you to focus and learn all the key knowledge involved in FP&A within a short period of time. It is especially helpful for working adults with families who are considering a career transition or professional advancement.

fpa.name: Kent Wong
fpa.quote: The content was well-structured, clear, and highly relevant to real-world applications. I especially appreciated the balance between theory and practical examples — it made the learning process both engaging and valuable.

fpa.name: Dawne Eng
fpa.quote: The course has been invaluable in giving me the specific FP&A skills I need to advance in my career and the templates are amazing. I'm so glad I invested in myself by taking this course.

fpa.name: Pramod Tamhane
fpa.quote: The Wharton Financial Planning program is exceptionally well structured and provides comprehensive insights into all aspects of financial planning. I highly recommend this program to finance professionals and executives looking to strengthen their financial planning expertise.

applied-value-investing.name: Leonard Kirsch
applied-value-investing.quote: The program is outstanding. I have taken similar courses at the Harvard Business School, and this course is more practical in its value to becoming a better investor.

applied-value-investing.name: Purushottaman Dwarakanathan
applied-value-investing.quote: This program stands as the most comprehensive, practical, and intellectually rigorous executive education experience I have participated in over the past decade. My understanding of valuation frameworks has been fundamentally transformed.

applied-value-investing.name: James Kurzawski
applied-value-investing.quote: The guest speaker videos alone are worth the tuition. The faculty are incredible and make this program truly unique. The balance between academic knowledge and practical, real-world understanding exceeded my expectations.

applied-value-investing.name: Yohan Mathew
applied-value-investing.quote: Before taking this course, I felt so behind my peers. Now I feel more confident, excited, and motivated to pursue a career in the buy-side. This is just an awesome resource.

applied-value-investing.name: Manohar Sunkum
applied-value-investing.quote: This is an excellent source of information and knowledge you could never get in books — very practical and taught by practitioners.

applied-value-investing.name: Danny Steadman
applied-value-investing.quote: Paul Johnson and the course content are outstanding. Extremely valuable experience. Best course I've ever taken part in!

applied-value-investing.name: Max Rabinovic
applied-value-investing.quote: The course provides an extremely detailed understanding of how to approach contrarian investing through guided research methods, modeling, theoretical frameworks, and structured investment pitches.

applied-value-investing.name: Michelle Tuchol
applied-value-investing.quote: I love the way the course material is put together: it's interactive, each week is broken into manageable chunks, and the ability to partner with the advisors, professors, and other classmates is the best!

ai-in-finance.name: Constantin Bansemer
ai-in-finance.quote: I had high expectations for this program and almost all of them were met. Better yet, I could not have hoped for a better teacher than Professor Guetta. It is so rare to have someone so deeply involved and motivated as a teacher.

ai-in-finance.name: Igor Akimushkin
ai-in-finance.quote: This is one of the best classes I have ever taken. It is a very comprehensive overview of traditional and AI methods that allows you to choose your own adventure. The Python code provided with extensive commentary is something I will reuse in my own projects.

ai-in-finance.name: Rudolph Carvajal
ai-in-finance.quote: There is so much hype and people selling AI right now. This certificate program provides students with real confidence around this topic and allows them to understand use cases and actually use this technology. Well worth the cost.

ai-in-finance.name: Don Fancher
ai-in-finance.quote: The planning and preparation by Daniel and team have been first rate. I felt I knew a lot but not as deep as needed, and this course has helped to expand my knowledge significantly.

ai-in-finance.name: Anna Ress
ai-in-finance.quote: Professor Guetta has done a wonderful job simplifying difficult concepts. Learning about cutting-edge techniques using LLMs and RAG will be directly applicable to my day-to-day work going forward.

ai-in-finance.name: Ryan Keller
ai-in-finance.quote: The program was highly valuable for early-to-mid career business professionals. The content is excellent for staying on top of emerging topics and trends in AI.

ai-in-finance.name: Michael Lean
ai-in-finance.quote: Daniel is an excellent professor. He provides information in a collaborative and energetic manner that keeps interest high. As advertised, it teaches the benefits and nuance of AI without forcing deep dives into granular coding. Time well spent.

ai-in-finance.name: Reuven Meshwork
ai-in-finance.quote: I have gained so much in such a short amount of time. The course is built beautifully — it is extremely engaging and the coursework is given over in a thorough yet easy-to-understand way.

hedge-fund.name: Meredith Henderson
hedge-fund.quote: This program is filled with practical information for finance professionals of all types. I'm learning skills that I'm able to immediately apply to make me a better analyst.

hedge-fund.name: Timothy Hartland
hedge-fund.quote: It's giving a real-life take on the world of buy-side finance with actionable processes and principles.

hedge-fund.name: George Zheng
hedge-fund.quote: I really like the organization of the content as well as the content itself. I also really like how the exams are structured.

hedge-fund.name: Deane Moore
hedge-fund.quote: I would recommend anyone who wants to learn about the hedge fund industry and do things the right way take this class.

hedge-fund.name: Josef Durand
hedge-fund.quote: I loved this course and would love to help TA it, if possible!

financial-modeling.name: Mikaela Zhang
financial-modeling.quote: The course is very helpful and the instructor Jesse is great. Jesse is very clear in explaining concepts and it's easy to follow. I would definitely recommend this to anyone looking to build their financial modeling skills.

financial-modeling.name: Matthew Sieger
financial-modeling.quote: Overall, a positive experience — gained a lot of relevant knowledge in a short amount of time. Jesse was great and easy to learn from.

financial-modeling.name: Fei Fan Tan
financial-modeling.quote: There is really a lot of thought behind choosing the panel of interviewers and the sequencing and layout of the overall curriculum. Many gems are dropped along the way — the amount of time needed to truly appreciate things at a deeper level is way longer than the prescribed duration.

financial-modeling.name: Nate Smith
financial-modeling.quote: Excellent program, engaging, supportive, and relevant. Good value for the spend.

financial-modeling.name: Chris Bendl
financial-modeling.quote: A very practical course with topical industry insights and solid curriculum, structured in an interesting format that really engages students.

wharton.name: Saupayan Mazumdar
wharton.quote: It's the best course I've done.

wharton.name: Justin Choi
wharton.quote: It was really helpful in learning core Excel skills and applying them in a hands-on, practical context.

wharton.name: Sydney Greene
wharton.quote: Very thorough with good practice materials.

wharton.name: Yusuke Shiota
wharton.quote: The course content is comprehensive and highly relevant, offering practical, real-world applications that directly benefit career growth. The instructors are knowledgeable and engaging, and I especially enjoyed the speaker series featuring different professionals.

wharton.name: Kia Maria Aejmelaeus
wharton.quote: The concept and process is extremely well thought out. The expert interviews are worth a special mention — they are really insightful and inspiring. I especially appreciate Scott Roman and his great energy and helpful approach.

wharton.name: Rich Keagy
wharton.quote: The program is done extremely well and I would suggest this to anyone that is willing to work hard to learn the PE business. The curriculum is thorough and has the information needed to get started and have a long career.
